Ruske Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Ruske, Ukraine

Not demolished. Presumably established in the 19th century, this cemetery existed by 1847 per epigraphic data, appearing on an 1865 cadastral map, used until WWII, with its latest preserved gravestone dated 1940; it was also used by the neighboring Jewish community of Stare Davydkovo. Jews are believed to have arrived in the 19th century; population reached 55 (of 897 total residents) by 1930. Many of the town's Jews were murdered during the Holocaust. No Jews live in the town today.
